messages:
maria_t: Async standup — audit queue / KMS rotation status. What I did / blockers / today:

maria_t: Did: finished audit for account-scoped IAM policies (PR #5043). Found two overly-broad roles on service accounts, created PR to tighten perms. Blocker: waiting on infra review for one SA change. Today: follow up + merge if green.

alexg: Did: ran KMS rotation dry-run in staging. Results: 2 failing keys (age > 730d) that are tagged vendor:external. Blocker: need vendor contact to rekey. Today: open ticket & escalate.

kevin: Did: triaged vuln scan output from last run, prioritized 5 high CVEs for patching. Blocker: one CVE repro is flaky in staging — need full logs to root cause. Today: try to reproduce with increased logging.

james_l: Did: deployed a canary vault-access policy tweak to reduce blast radius; tracing looks OK. Today: draft a short oncall runbook for KMS rotation steps and rollback.

security-bot: Automated report: weekly-audit-scan completed. Summary: 3 urgent alerts, ticket IDs SEC-3421, SEC-3422, SEC-3423. See dashboard: <https://console.redwood.internal/audit/weekly>.

maria_t: Ping @alexg for the vendor key owner — can you drop vendor contact or open a support ticket? Also ping @kevin for the repro logs: try `kubectl logs -n staging auth-service -c worker --since=2h` and dump to the log stream.

alexg: :thumbsup: I'll open a ticket to vendor. Ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INC-1987 (assigned to vendor-support). Added notes about required rekey window.

kevin: I couldn't find the logs — looks like the pod rotated and old logs were GC'd. Maria, can you re-run the failing job with `LOG_LEVEL=debug`? I'll add a temporary retention to the pod logging sidecar.

maria_t: On it. Re-ran the job with debug. Logs uploaded: <https://logs.redwood/streams/abc123>. Failing trace snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-03-17T09:15:32Z auth-worker: KV fetch timeout 500ms
stack: com.redwood.auth.KVTimeoutException: fetch timed out
    at com.redwood.auth.KVClient.get(KVClient.java:87)
    at com.redwood.auth.Worker.process(Worker.java:142)
```
Likely KV cache TTL mismatch + brief network blip to vault.

james_l: Action items recap:
1) @alexg — vendor ticket + escalate (SEC-1987) — due EOD.
2) @kevin — attach debug logs + open PR for dependency patch / config change — due tomorrow.
3) @maria_t — update dry-run + canary steps in the runbook (include `terraform` commands) — due EOD.
I'll add these to the rollout board and ping PM.

alexg: Assigned SEC-1987 to vendor-support and CC'd @maria_t. Asked for a maintenance window preference, ETA 48h.

maria_t: FYI I'm going to set the staging canary TTL to 30m to avoid extra rotations while we triage. Will `terraform apply` in ~30m and post plan: `terraform plan -target=module.kms`

kevin: Noted. Also dropped PR for the vuln patches: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5072 — tests flaky but I've left comments. Review ping to @maria_t and @alexg.

maria_t: Thanks all — if there are no other blockers I'll mark this thread :white_check_mark: and update the audit doc with links to SEC-3421/2/3 and INC-1987.

security-bot: Reminder: next full key-rotation dry-run scheduled in 5 days.

maria_t: ack, will add calendar invite for the dry-run rehearse.
